svg.title: How a request moves
svg.desc: How a request moves: the same wheel, stopped and seen face on. One request is one turn, and each of the eight spokes is a stage, read clockwise from the top: prompt; model a, model b, model c, three parallel calls; filter; output; trace; eval. One spoke lies outside the rim, labelled retry: the filter sent one call back; it fired again and passed.
